tasks.title: Lecture #75
tasks.instruction: Listen to a talk in a sociology class.
tasks.transcript:
Social capital is the network of relationships among people who live and work in a particular society. These networks enable society to function effectively. Social capital includes things like trust, mutual understanding and shared values, and also behaviors that bind people together and facilitate cooperation.
Social capital can be divided into two main types, bonding social capital and bridging social capital. Bonding social capital refers to the tight bonds within a close knit group, like family members or close friends. These strong ties are essential for providing support and assistance during times of need. Bridging social capital, on the other hand, involves connections that transcend different social groups, like relationships between acquaintances or colleagues from different backgrounds. These weaker ties are crucial for accessing new information and opportunities.
The benefits of social capital are numerous. It can give people emotional support, increase their access to resources and information and foster communal cooperation. And interestingly, people and communities with higher levels of social capital actually tend to have better health. Next, we will discuss how social capital can be measured and the challenges associated with its quantification.

questions.stem: What is the talk mainly about?

options.A: The differences between different types of social capital
options.B: The challenges of measuring social capital
options.C: The concept and benefits of social capital

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：这段谈话主要关于什么？ 定位原文：Social capital is the network of relationships... These networks enable society to function effectively. / The benefits of social capital are numerous. （全文先定义社会资本，再分类（bonding/bridging），最后讲好处） 选项分析： A. The differences between different types of social capital 不同类型社会资本之间的差异。谈话中确实区分了 bonding 和 bridging，但这不是全部内容，还包括定义和好处，所以A选项不全面。 B. The challenges of measuring social capital 衡量社会资本的挑战。谈话末尾提到 next 会讲 measuring，但这不是本段的主要内容，所以B选项错误。 C. The concept and benefits of social capital 社会资本的概念和好处。谈话介绍了社会资本的定义、分类以及带来的好处（情感支持、资源信息、健康等），所以C选项正确。 D. The importance of civic engagement 公民参与的重要性。谈话中未提及，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: According to the speaker, what is bonding social capital?

options.A: Connections that transcend different social groups
options.D: Relationships that enable access to new information

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：根据说话者，什么是 bonding social capital？ 定位原文：Bonding social capital refers to the tight bonds within a close knit group, like family members or close friends. 选项分析： A. Connections that transcend different social groups 超越不同社会群体的联系。这是 bridging social capital，不是 bonding，所以A选项错误。 B. Networks among acquaintances or colleagues 熟人或同事之间的网络。这是 bridging 的特征，不是 bonding，所以B选项错误。 C. Connections within close-knit groups 紧密联系群体内部的连接。说话者明确说“tight bonds within a close knit group”，所以C选项正确。 D. Relationships that enable access to new information 能够获取新信息的关系。这是 bridging social capital 的作用，不是 bonding 的定义，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: Why does the speaker mention "times of need"?

options.A: To give an example of a situation in which social capital is useful
options.B: To illustrate how bonds are formed
options.C: To suggest that family ties are stronger than other ties
options.D: To explain why bridging social capital is especially important

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：说话者为什么提到“困难时期（times of need）”？ 定位原文：These strong ties are essential for providing support and assistance during times of need. （前文在解释 bonding social capital） 选项分析： A. To give an example of a situation in which social capital is useful 举例说明社会资本有用的情境。说话者用“times of need”来说明强关系在需要支持时的重要性，所以A选项正确。 B. To illustrate how bonds are formed 说明关系是如何形成的。谈话中未讨论形成过程，所以B选项错误。 C. To suggest that family ties are stronger than other ties 暗示家庭纽带比其他关系更强。谈话中未比较强弱，所以C选项错误。 D. To explain why bridging social capital is especially important 解释为什么 bridging social capital 特别重要。这里讨论的是 bonding，不是 bridging，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What effect of social capital does the speaker consider interesting?
questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：说话者认为社会资本的哪个影响是有趣的？ 定位原文：And interestingly, people and communities with higher levels of social capital actually tend to have better health. 选项分析： A. High marriage rates 高结婚率。谈话中未提及，所以A选项错误。 B. Good health 良好的健康。说话者明确说“interestingly”和“better health”，所以B选项正确。 C. Communal cooperation 社区合作。谈话中提到这是 social capital 的好处之一，但没有用“interestingly”来强调，所以C选项错误。 D. Strong emotions 强烈的情感。谈话中未提及，所以D选项错误。
